snippet.title: Go! Go! PogoGirl | Official Trailer | Platform Like It's the 90's!
snippet.description:
The game will be available on Jan 26th 2022 on Steam and itch.io!

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681010/Go_Go_PogoGirl/

Itch.io:
https://ohsat-andrej.itch.io/go-go-pogogirl

Go! Go! PogoGirl is a dynamic, cute and wholesome platformer about a girl and her pogo stick. Bounce your way through the world, collect gems and then bounce some more!
